findings.statement: Source and 11 TTA runs contain 1839 unique episodes and final summaries. FeedTTA03 and all ATENA runs are partial snapshots (307, 284, 312, 294 episodes). Partial snapshot logs end during an unfinished episode without a traceback.

Nine full TTA result.json files are byte-identical. Their common SR is 56.878738 and SPL 50.504075. Relative to Source, SR increases 0.217509 percentage points (93 wins, 89 losses), while SPL decreases 0.013832 percentage points.

FSTTA01/02, EAM01/02/03 and FeedTTA01/02 have exactly the same recorded action chunks as Tent01 across 1839 episodes. Tent02 differs in one action sequence with identical episode metrics. FSTTA03 differs in four sequences; Tent03 in 867. All four partial runs exactly match the corresponding Tent01 prefix.

Tent01 and FeedTTA01/02 differ from Source in recorded action chunks for 1061/1839 episodes, although FeedTTA01/02 report final relative parameter drift 0.0. Their common small SR gain cannot be attributed to effective adaptation from these archives. The local v4 binding recomputes a float32 action readout and forces its token, so a native-score-aligned zero-update control is required to attribute changes.

updates counts optimizer invocations, not confirmed nonzero parameter changes. relative_param_drift is an end-of-run measure, not a per-update trace. overridden_first_actions compares adapter decision with the controller readout decision, not with the native decoder token; all-zero values do not establish source-action equality.

FSTTA01 performs only 1/459 slow updates; FeedTTA01/02 have final drift 0 despite 1839 feedback updates; EAM03 has drift 0.00271665 but zero action-sequence changes relative to Tent01. ATENA query rates are 96.13%, 63.46%, 99.66% in partial snapshots, so thresholds 0.1 and 0.15 barely limit feedback.

Tent01 wins the prescribed SPL/SR/lowest-LR rule; Tent02 is metrically tied. This is selection among archived v4 runs on a development split, not evidence of improvement over Source SPL or validation of a new runtime.

tent_val_seen_candidate.runtime_constraint: Archive winner belongs to v4 absolute-fp32-readout runtime. Preserve that runtime for paired legacy val_seen; a new native-score/delta parameterization is a different runtime and must be labeled accordingly.
tent_val_seen_candidate.selection_rule: highest complete val_unseen SPL, then SR, then lowest learning rate
